scope: Regional sort/health dispatch only. Capture/resolve and accepted layer work are retained. Not whole-game/finale or arbitrary-view certification.
baseline_provenance: Preserved empty-phase-optimized executable; SHA matches partition-empty-phase-2026-10-29 candidate. New baseline run manifests fingerprint current runner checkout, not reconstructed old sources.

result.cleanup: Every frame checks zero heads/counter after resolve, including overflow. Healthy pools recover in place, drain empty, and retain allocation size. Buffers are explicitly destroyed after completed GPU submissions; fresh-pool output matches. Not driver VRAM/free-history proof.
result.scope: Isolated native raster/scissor experiment using production sort/resolve bodies with fixture interfaces and Bevy-0.20 codec. Full projection, odd extent, opaque depth, premultiplied alpha and additive HDR. Detailed timing uses six queries and an attempt copy per region; aggregate-only uses two queries/frame and no per-region counter copies. Missing aggregate counters are not zero loss; that lane checks images and final reset only. Spans exclude initialization, opaque fixture, CPU work and post-pass readback; inter-region reset clears remain included. No simulation, material/light evaluation, actual Bevy phase integration, foreign transparency, MSAA, arbitrary views or game-performance acceptance.

timing_scope: Three per-run p95 ranges; no pooling/summing of quantiles. Aggregate includes health and clears/copies, excludes CPU bounds/bind-group preparation. Profile route readbacks omitted; image runs supply separate route/capacity controls. Live phase assignment is asynchronous.
